captions.detailed: A classic two-player upright arcade cabinet featuring a dark grey/black main body. The control panel is wide and angled, fitted with two joysticks topped with red and blue spherical knobs, along with small white buttons. On the lower front cabinet, there is a rectangular metal cashbox door and a smaller coin-return flap next to the coin slot. The cashbox door is designed to swing open on a vertical hinge, while the coin-return flap pivots on a horizontal hinge.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a commercial-scale upright arcade machine. It should feature a tall dark cabinet, an angled control panel with dual red and blue joysticks, and an articulated cashbox door on a vertical hinge along with a swinging coin-return flap on a horizontal hinge.
captions.factory: The arcade cabinet is built by defining a 2D profile of the side panel using a series of line and arc segments, which is then extruded to form the main body. The screen, control panel, joysticks (composed of cylinders and spheres), and coin slot details are added as separate visual elements positioned relative to the main cabinet. The cashbox door is modeled as a flat box and attached via a revolute joint rotating around the Z-axis, while the coin-return flap is modeled as a small box attached via a revolute joint rotating around the Y-axis.
